'''Barnibus''' was a [[Color/Legends|pink]]-skinned, pink-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], tame [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] that lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, the rancor was a smaller size than the normal height of a fully grown rancor, standing only slightly taller than an adult [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="CWO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Barnibus first appeared as a rare companion for players in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], which was released by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment in [[2010]]<ref name="CWO" /> and shut down in [[2014]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{WebCite|url=https://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1589|text=With Heavy Hearts, We Announce the Sunset of Clone Wars|author=George, Steve|date=01/24/2014|language=English|archivedate=20140314072821}}</ref> The rancor could only be obtained as a random reward from a sealed cargo crate, an object which players earned by completing mini-games and then had to open using access codes bought with station cash, a premium in-game currency. Barnibus was one of many possible items a player could obtain from such a crate. Given that obtaining Barnibus was entirely optional, this article makes no assumptions about if it was owned by a character.<ref name="CWO" />
